hooks.text: 白天建设经济与防线，夜晚亲自迎击不死军团
hooks.excerpt: Build by day, fight by night—defend your home with wit and blade! By day, you need to construct and upgrade 30 different buildings and units, allocate resources to develop your economy, and deploy soldiers to build an impenetrable defense line.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 六把武器各带专属技能和30项天赋，再叠加Rogue增益塑造流派
hooks.excerpt: The game offers 6 unique weapons, each with distinct skills and 30 upgradable talents. Defeating enemies in battle grants Rogue boons, allowing you to freely combine and create your own combat style.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 九张递增难度地图迎战40类怪物，并在终夜对决地图Boss
hooks.excerpt: At night, 40 different types of monsters will emerge, launching frenzied attacks. On the final night, the map's ultimate boss will personally descend—prepare for an epic showdown! 9 distinct maps, each with rising difficulty, will test your tactics and decisions.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
